name: Jack Of All Blades
description:
For each engagement die provided by equipment you’re wearing or wielding, add one additional die of the same type to your pool of engagement dice.

Additionally, once per round, you may switch one wielded weapon or shield for another as a free action instead of a half action.

Describe your expertise.

improvements.name: Master of Arms
improvements.description: Add two additional engagement dice of the same type instead of one.
